text: Program Description Teaching Objective The purpose of this program is to train high-level application-oriented professionals, who can grasp the fundamental theories, knowledge and skills in global economics and international trade; who should be quick in the awareness of the current economic development both at home and abroad; who can comprehend and apply into practice the current accepted standards, rules, regulations and laws in international trade and who can solve practical problems in this field. Program Course Structure This program will be in line with the international main-stream curriculums in the major of international economics and business, and combine the Chinese characteristics as well. The program emphasizes the internationalization, application, and case study. The students in this program will mainly study the basic theories and fundamental knowledge of economics, international economics and trade, receive the fundamental trainings of economics and management, and master the ability of theoretical analysis and doing the international trade business. All the courses of this program, excerpts a few Chinese-related ones, will be taught in English. Main Courses Brief introduction to China ,Microeconomics ,Macroeconomics, Introduction to Management, Human resource management, Accounting, Marketing, Economics and finance, Statistic for international business ,International trade law ,International business ,International finance & settlements ,International marketing ,Business communication and negotiation, Information management and knowledge management, WTO & Chinese economy, International relations and the global economy ,Logistics and supply management ,International business environment ,International trade practice ,Business Chinese ,Doing business in China. Internship Opportunity (1) Yiwu International Trade City; (2) Hangzhou new interesting network science and technology limited company. (3) Middle and small International trade enterprises; (4) Sunyard system engineering Limited by Share Ltd. Future Career Graduates are employed in a variety of sectors. Our graduates have always received good appraisal from all walks of life. The first employment rates are always ahead of the other colleges. The employment rate for undergraduate is over 95%. students should pay RMB 1000 Yuan in advance
